//: CompanyUno design-system governance for nexious-library, mirroring nexious-client's .stylelintrc.json. Lean on purpose: this config only enforces token adherence, it does NOT own formatting (prettier does). See roadmaps/specs/companyuno-design-language-and-redesign.md Section 5 for the token reference and roadmaps/specs/nexious-library-ui-rework-master-plan-2026-08-09.md for the rework this governs. Severity was 'warning' from Phase 1 (2026-08-09) through Phase 4 and is 'error' as of 2026-08-10: the ordering was deliberate, because erroring before the hex-to-token and radii sweep had run would have been a permanently red gate that everyone learns to ignore. Phase 1 recorded the baseline (266 warnings, 244 by the time Phase 4 started), Phase 4 drove it to zero, and only then did this flip. It is now a real signal: a new raw hex or off-scale radius fails `npm run lint:css` rather than joining a pile. This affects lint:css only, not `npm run build`, so it is not on the publish path unless CI runs it. The client hit exactly this ordering and the lesson from item 81 was that the token layer was always fine and what failed was governance, which is why this file existed before the sweep rather than after it.

color-no-hex.message: Use a design token (var(--...)) instead of a raw hex color. Hex belongs in vars/_tokens.scss, vars/_control.scss and vars/variables/_colors.scss only.

declaration-property-value-allowed-list.message: Use a scale token. Radius: var(--radius-*) or a canonical step (4/8/12/16px). Spacing: var(--space-*). Stray radii (5/6/7/10/15px) and raw rem spacing are the drift this rework is removing.

overrides.//: The token layer is where raw hex legitimately lives. vars/_tokens.scss defines the design-language tokens and their dark counterparts, vars/_control.scss defines the control geometry, and vars/variables/_colors.scss is the SCSS palette those partials still read from (unifying it onto the token layer is item 50 lane 2).
